description:
The Role

We’re looking for a Robot Operations Engineer who is passionate about robotics. This is a hands-on role where you will operate bimanual robots in R&D environments. You will follow structured procedures to collect high-quality robot data. This data is foundational to creating robots that perform tasks autonomously in the real world.

Responsibilities

• Assemble, test, and validate engineering systems.

• Accurately collect data consistent with a high internal quality bar.

• Maintain clear records of completed workflows and label data using internal tooling.

• Adhere to all safety guidelines in the lab.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer science, mechanical engineering, or a related field.

• Strong attention to detail and a proactive approach, including the confidence to raise questions or flag inconsistencies.

• Ability to follow written and verbal instructions precisely.

• Reliable transportation and ability to commute to the office.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus Qualifications

• Excellent physical coordination, spatial awareness, and focus.

• Passion for robotics.

Benefits & Compensation

• Hourly range: $25–$35.

• Expect to work 30–40 hours per week; this is a part-time role.
